prepared_by: Codex collecting agent (single reviewer); independent reviewer assigned

vulnerability.title: Jenkins lets users with Agent/Create but not Agent/Configure copy an agent containing secrets

fixed_releases.verified_content: The 2.504 release commit 5309fce4 has b3651b47 ([SECURITY-3513]) as its only parent, and the LTS 2.492.3 release commit a5462bf4 has acc9120f ([SECURITY-3513]) as its only parent (git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 0 for both). In both fixed trees ComputerSet.doCreateItem requires Agent/Extended Read and, when the caller lacks Agent/Configure, applies ExtendedReadRedaction.applyAll to the serialized node and rejects the copy with 403 if anything was redacted. The regression test PasswordTest.testCopyNodeSecrets asserts the 403 for a caller with Agent/Create and Agent/Extended Read but no Agent/Configure.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: NVD publishes a single CVSS 3.1 metric, 4.3 MEDIUM, from the Secondary source (CISA-ADP); there is no Primary metric. OSV/GHSA repeats the same 4.3 vector and records MODERATE, which is the same medium band. The CNA container has no CVSS metric. Every published severity level is medium, so the level is consistent and the score is not averaged.

vulnerability.category_l2: The agent copy endpoint authorizes only Agent/Create, then serializes and re-creates the source node with its secret fields, so a caller without Agent/Configure obtains a copy of the agent configuration containing those secrets

description: Jenkins creates agents from the ComputerSet page. When doCreateItem is called with mode=copy, it requires Agent/Create (Computer.CREATE) but performs no further authorization: it looks the source node up by name, serializes it with the full Jenkins.XSTREAM instance at line 266 (Secret fields are written as their encrypted values by Secret.ConverterImpl.marshal), converts the XML back into a Node and adds it as a new agent (267-271). A caller who holds Agent/Create but not Agent/Configure can therefore duplicate an agent whose configuration contains secrets. The advisory states this is due to an incomplete fix of SECURITY-3495: the 2.500 redaction work covered reading config.xml but not the copy endpoint. The 2.492.3/2.504 fix commits acc9120f and b3651b47 add, in the same branch, an Agent/Extended Read check and then, for callers without Agent/Configure, a pass of ExtendedReadRedaction.applyAll over the serialized XML; if the redaction changes anything (i.e., the agent contains secrets), the request is rejected with AccessDeniedException (403) and no node is created. The accompanying PasswordTest.testCopyNodeSecrets asserts that an Agent/Create+Configure user can copy a node with a secret while an Agent/Create+Extended Read user without Configure gets 403 and the computer count is unchanged.

critical_operation.description: The copy branch relies on the Agent/Create check at line 251 only. It serializes the source node with XSTREAM (which writes Secret values as encrypted strings) and re-creates it, with no Agent/Extended Read check, no Agent/Configure check and no redaction, so a caller lacking Agent/Configure receives a new agent carrying the source's secrets.

entry_point.description: HTTP POST /computer/createItem?mode=copy&from=<source-agent>&name=<new-agent> as a user holding Overall/Read and Agent/Create but not Agent/Configure; the endpoint is annotated @RequirePOST (line 246) and requires a crumb.

source_crosscheck.notes: The CNA, NVD, OSV and the GitHub advisory agree on the mechanism (the agent copy endpoint checks only Agent/Create, so a user without Agent/Configure can copy an agent containing secrets) and on the fixed releases (2.504 weekly, 2.492.3 LTS). NVD publishes no Primary metric; its only metric is the CISA-ADP Secondary 4.3 MEDIUM, which OSV/GHSA repeats as 4.3 MODERATE, and the CNA has no metric, so all published levels are medium. CWE-862 is recorded by NVD's Secondary source and by GHSA; the CNA lists none. The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.500 conflicts with the CNA text and the CVE GIT range (introduced 0); this dataset follows the CNA and GIT range and records the conflict. The vendor advisory states this issue is due to an incomplete fix of SECURITY-3495, which the dataset already covers through CVE-2025-27622 (agent config.xml) and CVE-2025-27623 (view config.xml); it is a distinct endpoint and a distinct advisory item (SECURITY-3513), and it is also distinct from the sibling SECURITY-3512 / CVE-2025-31720 (missing Agent/Extended Read check added by 81983c6a/bf32018b) which this dossier does not claim.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read ComputerSet.doCreateItem at 2.441 and confirm the copy branch checks only Agent/Create and serializes the source node without a Configure check.
An independent reviewer must confirm the fixed trees add the Extended Read check and the Configure/redaction guard, and that the fix commits are contained in releases 2.504 and 2.492.3.
An independent reviewer must confirm the affected range (weekly <=2.503, LTS <=2.492.2) and that 2.441 is inside it.
An independent reviewer must confirm all published severity levels are medium (4.3) and record CWE-862.
An independent reviewer must confirm this entry is distinct from CVE-2025-27622, CVE-2025-27623 and CVE-2025-31720.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Static verification only; no Jenkins instance, HTTP request or test was run.

The advisory does not spell out the exact route by which the copied secrets are subsequently read; the verified static facts are that the endpoint requires only Agent/Create, serializes the source configuration including Secret fields, and re-creates it as a new agent, and that the fix treats that as a Configure-level operation.

At 2.441 the extended-read permission is disabled by default (it is enabled by the hudson.security.ExtendedReadPermission system property), but the copy endpoint performs no extended-read check at all in that tree, which is what SECURITY-3512 (CVE-2025-31720) later added.
Only one location row is recorded (ComputerSet.doCreateItem copy branch). The fix adds two checks in the same branch; the location covers both.
The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.500 conflicts with the CNA and the CVE GIT range; the conflict is documented, not resolved silently.
open_questions: Whether the same copy endpoint behavior is reachable through any other UI path (for example job copying) was not enumerated; the advisory scopes it to agents.
